Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; county registration, first registration, title, renewal and the address-change rule resolve to the first selected page, the name-change rule, service member and veteran exemptions and new or foreign purchase documents to the second, and used out-of-state purchases, temporary permits, plate display and mopeds to the third.

Confidence: high across the section; every rule is stated directly on its page. One source-form caution: the moped licensing paragraph on the third page is doubled in the snapshot's text layer, so its two sentences were confirmed against the rendered page, which states them plainly.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
